items.detail: Ten basketball events were listed, including nine NBA games, but no official NBA fixture data could be read: the games page returned its shell with an error message, and the scoreboard endpoints returned HTTP 500 or failed.

items.detail: Nine race listings were captured, but GBGB does not publish per-race dog form or trap data at a URL reachable here, so no greyhound pick is published.
Six tennis matches were listed for 25-26 October. No ATP or WTA page was read in this capture window, so no fixture, ranking or form fact is asserted.
items.needs: An ATP/WTA match page for each listed match.

items.detail: Eleven cricket events were listed, including a Pakistan v England ODI and four CSA T20 games. No governing-body page was read in this capture, so no cricket pick is published.
items.needs: A board or ICC fixture page for each listed match.

items.detail: Twelve volleyball matches were listed across Austrian, German, Polish, French, Dutch, Brazilian and Italian leagues. No league page was read in this capture.
items.needs: A league fixture/standings page per competition.

items.detail: Ten handball matches were listed. The Bundesliga fixture URL tried returned HTTP 404, so no handball fixture could be confirmed.
items.needs: A working HBL and ASOBAL fixture/standings page.

items.detail: Five PDC matches were listed. Four of them had displayed start times before the capture window and no PDC page was read, so none is published.
One snooker match was listed (Mark Williams v Jak Jones). The WST match centre was read only as far as the Round 1 results, so the match could not be confirmed from the governing body.
items.needs: The WST page section covering 24 October.

items.detail: Four club matches were listed (Galway, Cork and Limerick championships). No county-board page was read, so no Gaelic pick is published.
items.needs: County board fixture pages with throw-in times.

items.detail: The United States Grand Prix was listed for 25 October with Max Verstappen the most-tipped driver. No Formula 1 page was read in this capture, so no motor-racing pick is published.
items.needs: The Formula 1 event page and grid/qualifying result.

items.detail: One officially sourced baseball fixture exists (the World Series game). The five-per-sport target cannot be met from a single scheduled game.
Anaheim at Philadelphia was scheduled for 17:00Z, before the 17:45Z selection cut-off, so it is shown as a fixture but carries no pick.
Buffalo at Washington was confirmed by the NHL feed but no OLBG event id for it appeared on the Ice Hockey hub page read, so a bet could not be placed on it from the listing we captured.
items.needs: The OLBG listing to appear on a later page of the hub.

items.detail: "High confidence means 70% or better" and "the price must sit between -250 and +10000" can only both hold between 70.00% and 71.43%, because -250 is 71.43%. The New Jersey pick is a 73.6% (-279) call and is therefore published as high confidence but marked outside the band rather than repriced to fit.
items.needs: A decision on which rule wins.

items.detail: OLBG's displayed times for NHL games are US Eastern clock times plus about seven minutes (for example "Today 19:07" for a 23:00Z start). They are stored verbatim and never used as kick-off times.
items.needs: Nothing; recorded so the column is not misread.

items.detail: 96 listing rows were read from the first page of each of the 15 sport hubs. Each hub is paginated with a "Load More Tips" control, so this is not a complete OLBG inventory.
items.needs: Paged reads of every hub to complete the inventory.
